name: useful-dsh-plugins-dev
description: Build-time dev store for the plugins in this repo. Plugins declare their @deepseek-ai/* packages as peerDependencies (the harness provides them at runtime), so nothing here is a runtime dependency of any published package — this file exists so the resolutions the plugins are built and typechecked against are reproducible, and so the harness's profile module fallback (`.dsh-module-fallback`, healed by dsh-app-boot) has a stable place to resolve the two client packages the 0.1.5 bundle does not ship.
